scope: Curated representative official and professional guidance for human-centered urban street and road design; metadata and official links only.
coverage_gaps: Recheck all living web guidance and legal sources before project use.
Add project-specific local authority standards after the jurisdiction is known.
Many paid CROW, FGSV, AASHTO, and TAC documents require licensed access for clause-level comparison.
Coverage is representative rather than mathematically exhaustive.
